module origen_023851 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    output reg led,
    output reg [14:0] sram_addr,
    output reg sram_wr_n,
    inout wire [7:0] sram_data
);

    reg [25:0] delay;
    reg [7:0] wr_data, rd_data;
    reg [14:0] addr_r;
    reg [2:0] state, next_state;
    reg [2:0] cnt;
    reg [7:0] sram_data_out;
    reg sram_data_oe;

    localparam IDLE = 3'd0, WRT0 = 3'd1, WRT1 = 3'd2, REA0 = 3'd3, REA1 = 3'd4;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            delay <= 26'd0;
            wr_data <= 8'd0;
            addr_r <= 15'd0;
            state <= IDLE;
            cnt <= 3'd0;
            led <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            delay <= delay + 1'b1;
            state <= next_state;

            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (delay == 26'd9999) begin
                        next_state <= WRT0;
                    end else if (delay == 26'd19999) begin
                        next_state <= REA0;
                    end else if (delay == 26'd29999) begin
                        wr_data <= wr_data + 1'b1;
                        addr_r <= addr_r + 1'b1;
                        next_state <= IDLE;
                    end else begin
                        next_state <= IDLE;
                    end
                end

                WRT0: begin
                    if (cnt == 3'd4) begin
                        next_state <= WRT1;
                        cnt <= 3'd0;
                    end else begin
                        cnt <= cnt + 1'b1;
                        next_state <= WRT0;
                    end
                end

                WRT1: begin
                    if (cnt == 3'd4) begin
                        next_state <= IDLE;
                        cnt <= 3'd0;
                    end else begin
                        cnt <= cnt + 1'b1;
                        next_state <= WRT1;
                    end
                end

                REA0: begin
                    if (cnt == 3'd4) begin
                        next_state <= REA1;
                        cnt <= 3'd0;
                    end else begin
                        cnt <= cnt + 1'b1;
                        next_state <= REA0;
                    end
                end

                REA1: begin
                    if (cnt == 3'd4) begin
                        next_state <= IDLE;
                        cnt <= 3'd0;
                        rd_data <= sram_data;
                        led <= (rd_data == wr_data);
                    end else begin
                        cnt <= cnt + 1'b1;
                        next_state <= REA1;
                    end
                end

                default: next_state <= IDLE;
            endcase
        end
    end

    always @(*) begin
        sram_addr = addr_r;
        sram_wr_n = (state == WRT0 || state == WRT1) ? 1'b0 : 1'b1;
        sram_data_out = wr_data;
        sram_data_oe = (state == WRT0 || state == WRT1);
    end

    assign sram_data = sram_data_oe ? sram_data_out : 8'bz;

endmodule
